title: CS Learn
excerpt: Free lectures from Carnegie Mellon's Kenneth C. Griffin School of Computer Science, now on YouTube. Self-paced courseware comes next.
content_html:
Computer science from Carnegie Mellon. Free, online, at your pace.

Free lectures now on YouTube. Free courseware coming next.

Carnegie Mellon's CS classroom, doors open to all.

Watch our faculty teach across AI, robotics, systems, biology, and more, from seven departments that lead their fields.
